headline: CVS Health to Split Pharmacy and Insurance Businesses Into Two
summary: CVS Health announced plans to split into two separate companies, dividing its retail pharmacy operations from its health insurance business.
why: Corporate breakups of large diversified healthcare conglomerates aim to unlock shareholder value by allowing distinct business segments to operate independently with focused strategies.

impacts.name: CVS Health
impacts.why: The structural split directly reorganizes CVS Health's corporate structure into two independent entities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Corporate restructuring announcements involving major enterprise breakups typically trigger significant investor reassessment of sum-of-the-parts valuations.
